title: 第02章 最后一相
slug: 夜天子全本免费-夜天子最新章节列表
content_zh:
叶小天的狱卒身份继承自他的老爹，老叶家是世袭的狱卒，这是洪武皇爷定下的规矩：子继父业，代代传承。
你要是当兵的，你儿子里头就必须得有一个当兵的，要是你家婆娘不争气没给你生个男丁，那就从你家亲戚里找一个，要是你家亲戚里也没有男丁，那就随便你去哪里找一个，哪怕你从大街上拐一个来，反正得补上这个缺。
你要是匠户里的厨役户，但是你还没学会炒菜你老爹就死翘翘了，你压根儿就不会做饭，那也不要紧，官府需要召集厨役户的时候你去就成了，不会做饭烧火总成吧？反正你做的饭当官儿的是不吃的，人数要对上。如果你是个医户，而且你不懂医术……，那我们提前向病人默哀就好。
叶家的狱卒身份传到叶小天的爹叶老爷子那辈儿时就一根独苗苗。但叶老爹很争气，他一口气就生了对双胞胎，长子叶小安，次子叶小添。小添是意外发现居然是双胞胎，又添了一个儿子的意思。
叶小添对这个俗气的名字实在不喜欢，又因为已经被人叫惯了，再改个新名字也不能敲锣打鼓地普告天下，于是向老子郑重抗议之后，经老爷子同意，叶小添就变成了叶小天。
叶老爷子的狱卒身份只能传给一个儿子，照理说应该传给先从娘肚子里爬出来的那个叶小安，只是小安小时候受过惊吓，有一回他一掀被窝，堪堪瞧见一条从隔壁餐馆爬出来，藏进他被窝的菜花蛇，从此变得特别怯懦老实。
叶老爷子考虑到天牢里人精扎堆儿，不太适合这个老实儿子，所以就把一生积蓄拿出来，给大儿子开了家米面油坊，把天牢狱卒这份有前途的职业传给了他的次子叶小天。
叶小天替黄侍郎置办好了酒菜回到天牢，瞧瞧天色办完这件差就该交班了，便加快了脚步，不料刚刚进了天牢，就见司狱官刘大人远远的从庑廊下走过来，叶小天连忙站住，老远的就向刘大人施礼。
司狱官名叫刘勇，五十出头的年纪，赤红色的一张脸庞，个头不高，却很墩实，衣着服饰与叶小天差不多，只是在青衣外面又罩了一条红色的背甲。
司狱是从九品的小官，再可小那也是官，尤其是在这天牢玄字一号监里他是说一不二的人物，是以举止之间，颇有一种睥睨不凡的气概。
叶小天欠身笑道：“刘司狱好。”
“嗯！”
刘勇从鼻子里哼了一声，瞟一眼他手里的食盒，晓得是在捞外快。这些狱卒每月都有孝敬给他，所以对这种不坏大规矩的事情他一向睁只眼闭只眼。
刘司狱道：“你来的正好，厨下正在准备酒肉，一会儿你就给杨霖送进去吧。”
叶小天奇怪地道：“莫名其妙的怎么给杨神棍加菜？啊！莫不是他的案子判下来了，这是……要上菜市口？”
叶小天自从接替了他爹这份差使，给牢里送过的酒肉不计其数，但是除了犯官们自己花钱买的酒肉，他只送过五份，每送一份，就代表一条人命即将离去。
刘勇没有回答，只是淡淡地瞟了他一眼，负起双手扬长而去。叶小天怔立片刻，轻轻摇一摇头，便举步向玄字一号监走去。
叶小天把酒肉交给黄侍郎，转身又来到杨霖的牢房前，就见杨霖盘膝坐在地上，正把几枚石子抛在面前空地上，看着石子的落势念念有词，大概在推演伏羲六十四卦。
叶小天清咳一声道：“杨大人。”
杨霖抬头见是叶小天，马上舍了那些石子，欣欣然地迎到牢前，笑嘻嘻地道：“看来小兄弟对西洋星座术很感兴趣呀，可是想让老夫接着给你算一算么？”

叶小天笑道：“得了，用西洋人的玩意儿算咱大明人的命，总叫人感觉怪怪的，杨大人还是给小子看看相吧。”
只要有机会卖弄本事，杨霖就开心的很了，至于用什么相术，杨霖倒是不挑。隔着一道木栅栏，他仔细端详半晌，抚掌叹道：“小兄弟，你骨骼清奇、发黑唇红、眼大眉秀，此乃大富之相啊……”
“哦？”叶小天抚了抚自己的眉，眉头随之一挑。
杨霖道：“额头主掌才智和运气，你额头高平饱满，所以有聪明才智，少年即可行大运。鼻子主掌财富和女人缘，你鼻子直挺丰厚，贯通额头，少年时即可财运亨通，桃花朵朵。”

content_en:
Ye Xiaotian inherited his identity as a jailer from his father. The old Ye family is a hereditary jailer. This is a rule set by Emperor Hongwu: sons inherit their father's business and pass it on from generation to generation.
If you are a soldier, one of your sons must be a soldier. If your mother-in-law fails to live up to expectations and fails to give you a boy, then find one from your relatives. If there are no boys among your relatives, then you can find one wherever you want. Even if you get one off the street, you have to fill the gap anyway.
If you are a cook in a craftsman's household, but your father died before you learned how to cook, and you don't know how to cook at all, that doesn't matter. When the government needs to summon a cook, you can just go. You can't cook and light the fire, right? Anyway, the officials won’t eat the food you cook, so the number of people must match. If you are a doctor and you don’t know medical skills... then we can just mourn the patient in advance.
The identity of the Ye family's jailer was passed down to Ye Xiaotian's father, Mr. Ye, who was a single person when he was a child. But Father Ye was so proud that he gave birth to twins in one breath, the eldest son Ye Xiaoan and the second son Ye Xiaotian. Xiao Tian unexpectedly discovered that they were twins, which meant they had another son.
Ye Xiaotian really didn't like this tacky name, and because he was used to being called a new name, he couldn't announce it to the world with gongs and drums, so after solemnly protesting to the old man, and with the old man's consent, Ye Xiaotian became Ye Xiaotian.
Mr. Ye's identity as a jailer can only be passed down to one son, and logically it should be passed on to Ye Xiaoan, the one who crawled out of his mother's belly first. However, Xiaoan was frightened when he was a child. One time when he lifted the quilt, he saw a cauliflower snake crawling out from the restaurant next door and hiding under his quilt. From then on, he became particularly timid and honest.
Mr. Ye considered that the large number of people in Tianlao was not suitable for his honest son, so he spent his life savings to open a rice flour and oil shop for his eldest son, and passed on the promising career of jailer in Tianlao to his second son Ye Xiaotian.
Ye Xiaotian bought wine and food for Huang Shilang and returned to the Tianyao. After looking at the weather, it was time to hand over the shift after finishing this errand, so he quickened his pace. Unexpectedly, just as he entered the Tianyao, he saw the prison officer Mr. Liu coming from a distance from the verandah. Ye Xiaotian stopped quickly and saluted Mr. Liu from a distance.
The prison officer's name is Liu Yong. He is in his early fifties, with a red face. He is not tall but very stocky. His clothes are similar to Ye Xiaotian's, except that he wears a red back armor on top of his green clothes.
The jailer is a junior official from the ninth rank, no matter how small he is, he is still an official. Especially in this jail No. 1, Xuanzi, Tianlao, he is an indispensable figure, so there is quite a scornful air in his behavior.
Ye Xiaotian leaned over and smiled: "Hello Liu Siyu."
"Yeah!"
Liu Yong snorted from his nose and glanced at the food box in his hand, knowing that he was making extra money. These jailers paid him tribute every month, so he always turned a blind eye to such things that were not breaking the rules.
Liu Siyu said: "You came just in time. The kitchen is preparing wine and meat. You can bring it in for Yang Lin soon."
Ye Xiaotian said strangely: "How can I add food to Yang Shengun for no apparent reason? Ah! Could it be that his case has been judged and he is...going to be sold in the market?"
Since Ye Xiaotian took over his father's job, he has delivered countless wines and meats to the prison. However, apart from the wines and meats bought by the prisoners themselves, he has only delivered five portions. Each delivery represents a life that is about to be lost.
Liu Yong didn't answer, just glanced at him lightly, put up his hands and walked away. Ye Xiaotian stood stunned for a moment, shook his head slightly, and walked towards Xuanzi Prison No. 1.
Ye Xiaotian handed the wine and meat to Huang Shilang, turned around and came to Yang Lin's cell, and saw Yang Lin sitting cross-legged on the ground, throwing a few stones into the open space in front of him, watching the falling of the stones and mumbling, probably deducing Fuxi's sixty-four hexagrams.
leafXiao Tianqing coughed and said, "Master Yang."
Yang Lin raised his head and saw that it was Ye Xiaotian. He immediately threw away the stones and happily walked to the cell. He said with a smile: "It seems that my little brother is very interested in Western horoscopes, but do you want me to calculate it for you?"
Ye Xiaotian smiled and said: "Come on, it always feels weird to use Western things to calculate the fate of Ming people. Master Yang should show the boy his fortune."
As long as there is a chance to show off his skills, Yang Lin will be very happy. As for what kind of physiognomy to use, Yang Lin doesn't choose. Across a wooden fence, he looked at it carefully for a long time, stroking his palms and sighing: "Little brother, you have strange bones, dark lips, big eyes and beautiful eyebrows. This is the sign of a rich man..."
"Oh?" Ye Xiaotian stroked his eyebrows and raised them.
Yang Lin said: "The forehead is in charge of intelligence and luck. Your forehead is high, flat and full, so if you are smart and talented, you will have great luck in your youth. Your nose is in charge of wealth and popularity with women. If your nose is straight and plump, running through your forehead, you will have good fortune and peach blossoms in your youth."
